title: Whipped Dalgona Coffee over Cold Milk
summary: Instant coffee, sugar and hot water are whisked into a stiff, glossy foam and spooned over glasses of iced whole milk.
equipment: balloon whisk or electric hand mixer

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: Put the instant coffee, sugar and hot water in the bowl. Whisk vigorously by hand for 6-8 minutes, or 2-3 minutes with the mixer, until thick, glossy, pale caramel and holding soft peaks.

steps.title: Fill the glasses
steps.text: Put a few ice cubes in each glass and pour in 240 ml cold milk.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Spoon a quarter of the whipped coffee onto each glass, swirling it into a mound.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight away with a spoon, and stir the coffee into the milk before drinking.

tips: Only instant coffee whips; brewed or ground coffee won't hold a foam.
Use a wide bowl and tilt it so the whisk stays in the mixture.
Decaffeinated instant coffee whips just as well.
For a hot version, spoon the foam over warm milk instead.
storage: The whipped coffee keeps covered in the fridge for up to 1 day; assemble just before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
